title: UX Responsive Structure Compiler
description: Validates responsive structure specs: breakpoint coverage, content disclosure, navigation mode declarations, breakpoint conflict detection, collapsible region definitions, and contract attestation. Produces responsive-structure-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract responsive-spec.json from feature brief and breakpoint definitions

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape and detect breakpoint conflicts

pipeline.title: Coverage
pipeline.description: Validate breakpoint tier coverage, content disclosure, and navigation mode declarations

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: responsive-spec.json exists with breakpoints(array); each breakpoint has name, minWidth, layout; must include mobile and desktop

gates.title: No Breakpoint Conflicts
gates.description: No two breakpoints may have the same minWidth value

gates.title: All Breakpoints Defined
gates.description: Spec must cover mobile (<=480), tablet (481-1023), and desktop (>=1024); escape hatch: mobileOnly or desktopOnly

gates.title: No Content Loss
gates.description: Any region with hidden:true must declare disclosureTarget or hiddenIntentional:true

gates.title: Nav Mode Declared
gates.description: If spec has navigation object, each breakpoint must declare navMode

gates.title: Hierarchy Collapse
gates.description: Any region in spec.collapsibleRegions must declare collapsedAt(array) and collapseType

gates.title: Responsive Structure Contract
gates.description: Version, unique breakpoint names, breakpoints sorted by minWidth ascending

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled responsive structure specs

error_codes.URS001: responsive-spec.json missing or invalid — breakpoints array with name, minWidth, layout required; mobile and desktop breakpoints required
error_codes.URS002: Missing breakpoint tier — mobile (<=480), tablet (481-1023), or desktop (>=1024) not covered
error_codes.URS003: Hidden region missing disclosure mechanism — declare disclosureTarget or hiddenIntentional:true
error_codes.URS004: Navigation breakpoint missing navMode — must be topbar, sidebar, hamburger, tabs, or bottom-bar
error_codes.URS005: Duplicate breakpoint minWidth — no two breakpoints may share the same boundary
error_codes.URS006: Collapsible region missing collapsedAt or collapseType declaration
error_codes.URS007: Responsive structure contract violation — version, unique breakpoint names, or sort order invalid
